description: The daemon page router (page-router.md): what each cmux page may call and which subscribe events it hears, and which v2 operation namespaces the daemon routes to an owner outside the operation catalog. The one source: the daemon embeds this file, and bindings/codegen/page_router.py generates the page clients' table from it.

home-channels.description: Channels (Home). It reads conversations through the raw conversation commands of its authenticated WebSocket, so it needs no v2 operation. Its WebSocket keeps its raw subscribe; a page relay of this page gets no event stream.

history.description: History. Reads the merged history; a delete needs the person's gesture (hq-99 rule on cmux#13742); it hears history-changed, so an open page re-reads when history changes.

apps.description: App Store. Reads the catalog and the installed-app panels (grants, logs, icons). Hide/Show and revoking a scope need the person's gesture (they never widen what an app may do); an install, uninstall, allowed scope or other change needs the person's confirmation on a native sheet (never a click alone: a change can turn off an app's sandbox).
The App Store owner (the app supervisor's store; raw `apps-store {op, args}`). Unix socket and authenticated WebSocket connections; mutations need origin user.
